_about: Self-contained ground truth for the PII types the prospectus does not contain.
The Red Herring Prospectus is an Indian corporate filing: it has names, companies,
addresses, e-mails and phone numbers in abundance, but no Social Security Numbers, no
credit cards, no IP addresses and no dates of birth. Reporting 'recall = n/a' for four
of the nine required types would say nothing about whether they work, so this suite
exercises them on ticket-log style text of the shape the assignment describes.
Every record deliberately mixes true positives with near-miss decoys - order numbers,
ticket ids, invoice totals, version strings, business dates - so the same corpus scores
precision as well as recall. All identifiers are synthetic: the card numbers are the
public test values, the SSNs are structurally valid but arbitrary, the Aadhaar numbers
